items.source: Nearest neighbor search index type. Options are NONE - exact nearest neighbor search, IVFFlat - index divides vectors into lists, and then searches a subset of those lists that are closest to the query vector. It has faster build times and uses less memory than HNSW, but has lower query performance (in terms of speed-recall tradeoff). HNSW - creates a multilayer graph. It has slower build times and uses more memory than IVFFlat, but has better query performance (in terms of speed-recall tradeoff). There’s no training step like IVFFlat, so the index can be created without any data in the table.
items.translation: 最近邻搜索索引类型。选项包括 NONE - 精确最近邻搜索；IVFFlat - 索引将向量划分为列表，然后搜索最接近查询向量的子集列表。它比 HNSW 的构建速度更快且占用内存更少，但查询性能较低（在速度与召回率权衡方面）。HNSW - 创建多层图。它的构建速度比 IVFFlat 慢且占用内存更多，但在查询性能上更好（在速度与召回率权衡方面）。它不像 IVFFlat 那样有训练步骤，因此可以在表中没有任何数据的情况下创建索引。

items.source: Search distance type. Defaults to COSINE_DISTANCE. But if vectors are normalized to length 1, you can use EUCLIDEAN_DISTANCE or NEGATIVE_INNER_PRODUCT for best performance.
items.translation: 搜索距离类型。默认为 COSINE_DISTANCE。但如果向量已归一化为长度 1，您可以使用 EUCLIDEAN_DISTANCE 或 NEGATIVE_INNER_PRODUCT 以获得最佳性能。

items.source: This section walks you through setting up the PGvector VectorStore to store document embeddings and perform similarity searches.

items.source: PGvector is an open-source extension for PostgreSQL that enables storing and searching over machine learning-generated embeddings. It provides different capabilities that let users identify both exact and approximate nearest neighbors. It is designed to work seamlessly with other PostgreSQL features, including indexing and querying.
items.translation: PGvector 是一个用于 PostgreSQL 的开源扩展，支持对机器学习生成的嵌入（embeddings）进行存储和搜索。它提供多种功能，允许用户识别精确和近似最近邻。它的设计旨在与 PostgreSQL 的其他功能（包括索引和查询）无缝配合。
